name: Zebulun
bio: Zebulun is the sixth son of Jacob and Leah, and the last son Leah bore herself. At his birth she said, "God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons," and named him "Zebulun," meaning "dwelling" or "honor" (Genesis 30:19-20). Zebulun later became one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
